title: Summarize an app crash and hotfix
prompt: Summarize the following in one sentence: The mobile app crashed for approximately 20% of iOS users during the update rollout yesterday; the issue has since been identified as a memory leak and a hotfix has already been deployed.

metadata.notes: Correct: mentions the crash and its scope (20% of iOS users), the root cause (memory leak), and that a hotfix is already deployed. Graded manually.
